capabilities: Resize images to preset or exact widths, with corner-grip resizing on mobile
Align images left, center, or right and wrap text around them
Add and edit plain-text captions without editing link syntax
Reveal, copy, or open the attachment fullscreen via more-actions menu
Reset layout or remove an image from the note while keeping the attachment
disambiguation: Not an image editor; it does not convert, compress, crop, rotate, or annotate images, only controls their size, placement, and captions in notes.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13 or newer; not yet in the community plugin directory, installable manually or via BRAT. No telemetry; optional paste/drop handler is off by default. Author of this plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Image Kit puts these controls beside Obsidian’s native image actions on desktop and mobile.
problem: Obsidian's native image controls only offer zoom and resize, with no built-in way to set alignment or captions without hand-editing link syntax.

relations.evidence: Image Kit delegates fullscreen viewing to Fullscreen Image when enabled, or to Obsidian otherwise.

summary: Image layout toolbar that sizes, aligns, and captions images in Live Preview, saving the layout in the image link itself.
